opportunities.name: Unseen Return Strike
opportunities.objective: Count P packets after each verified unseen interval.
opportunities.mechanic: P refreshes when unseen and adds AD-scaled magic damage plus slow to the next champion attack. R primary description grants invisibility and explicitly triggers P; Trinity/Sundered Sky support one real return attack, Stridebreaker assists leaving vision and re-entering. No resolved R duration is assumed.
opportunities.requiredState: Record actual R evolution/casts and whether enemy vision truly loses Khazix.
opportunities.failure: Detection or kiting denies P refresh and access.
opportunities.test: Count P packets after each verified unseen interval; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Every R cast is not automatically a fresh attack or a ready Spellblade proc.

opportunities.name: Isolated Claw Repeat
opportunities.objective: Compare Q count while isolated versus beside an ally.
opportunities.mechanic: Q primary description grants increased physical damage against Isolated targets and evolved-Q cooldown refund. Shojin and AD support repeated physical casts; Eclipse tests two separate hit windows and Cleaver supports repeated physical damage. R escape preserves isolation rather than assuming it persists.
opportunities.requiredState: Choose Q evolution and keep target separated from allies; confirm live cooldown refund.
opportunities.failure: An ally/minion joining invalidates isolation or unresolved coefficients change damage.
opportunities.test: Compare Q count while isolated versus beside an ally; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Isolation and evolved Q are conditional, not free permanent multipliers.

ruledOut.reason: Primary Q/W/E descriptions explicitly identify physical damage; P is a separate magic attack bonus.

unknowns: All primary resolved tooltips select unresolved conditional templates. Q/W/E/R mechanics use primary descriptions only; evolution coefficients, ranges and timers cannot be numerically ranked from these records.
StatFormula annotations remain symbolic; verify the affected stat basis before numerical comparison.
Unresolved conditional/runtime tooltip tokens prevent a complete numerical model; retained helpers do not establish live behavior.

testPlan: Required state: Record actual R evolution/casts and whether enemy vision truly loses Khazix.
Count P packets after each verified unseen interval; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Detection or kiting denies P refresh and access.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Every R cast is not automatically a fresh attack or a ready Spellblade proc.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Trinity Force, Sundered Sky, Stridebreaker, Eclipse, Death's Dance, Mercury's Treads. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.
builds.author: ChatGPT

kitEvidence.formula:
When Kha'Zix is not visible to the enemy team, his next Attack against a champion deals an additional [characterLevelTable[15, 22, 29, 36, 43, 50, 57, 64, 71, 78, 85, 92, 99, 106, 113, 120, 127, 134, 141, 148, 155, 162, 169, 176, 183, 190, 197, 204, 211, 218, 225] + (0.5) × AD[statFormula=2]] magic damage and Slows by [25]% for [2] seconds.

Enemies with no nearby allies become Isolated.
